split_method: Assign topics before retrieval: reserve sections 1.4, 1.7, 2.4, 2.7 and 2.8 for test; all other question topics are dev. Not a random split.
leakage_limitations: All questions use the same book and chapters. Related concepts, summaries and mixed-section pages can overlap across splits.
Test authorship/evidence validation requires reading test questions; no retrieval experiments have been run at creation time. Do not use subsequent test scores or traces to tune strategies.
Vietnamese queries over English sources require an appropriate embedding model; keep the same model and query/document processing for every strategy.

filter_policy.input_origin: The requested chapter is explicitly present in each filtered question before retrieval.
filter_policy.A: Ignore filter; vector retrieval over the whole corpus.
filter_policy.B: Ignore filter; vector retrieval over the whole corpus.
filter_policy.C: Apply the supplied chapter filter; if filter is empty, retrieve without filtering.
filter_policy.B_C_comparison: Use identical chunks/model/store/metric and vary only metadata filtering.

ranking: prefer A, then B, then C if still tied
selection_rule.test_policy: Freeze strategies after dev selection, then evaluate all three once on the same five test questions. Record results without further tuning.

metrics.hit_definition: A hit must match a documented gold source/page and contain sufficient primary or alternative evidence. Whitespace-normalized substring match is an automatic proxy; record human adjudication for equivalent evidence.
metrics.grounding: Manual 0/1/2 evidence sufficiency labels on five test questions for every strategy; no LLM answer-accuracy claim.
metrics.metadata: Audit source/page/chapter on test top-3; filter compliance uses only filtered questions.
metrics.coherence: Manual 0/1/2 labels at the same ten preselected source positions for all strategies.

evidence_verification: Whitespace-normalized quotes selected from page text and checked against original PDF text extraction; semantic support reviewed during authorship. No visual inspection or human audit scores claimed.
